triggers.detailsText: Terminals (India) Private Limited, a subsidiary in which Accuracy Shipping Limited holds a 99.80% stake, has received a Letter of Intent (LoI) dated September 10, 2026, from the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) for setting up a Container Freight Station (CFS) at Kandla, Gujarat. The project entails an estimated capital expenditure of approximately ₹25 crore, which is proposed to be funded through a combination of debt and internal accruals. At peak operations and full utilization, the CFS is expected to generate revenue of approximately ₹175–200 crore, with the EBITDA margin expected to grow to double-digit levels as operations scale up.
